name: Culebrasuchus
sum: Early to Middle Miocene caiman from the Culebra Formation of Panama, an early participant in the Great American Interchange.
holotype: A skull and three neck vertebrae from the Culebra Formation, Panama.
biology: Its ancestors probably lived farther north, perhaps in southern Mexico, since most of Panama was under water before the Miocene.
author: Hastings et al. 2013

sources.text: Hastings, A. K.; Bloch, J. I.; Jaramillo, C. A.; Rincon, A. F.; MacFadden, B. J. 2013. Systematics and biogeography of crocodylians from the Miocene of Panama. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 33(2). doi:10.1080/02724634.2012.713814
